description:
The mood on X (Twitter) about a coin or crypto topic in the last 24 hours: bullish, bearish, mixed or quiet, a score from -1 (very bearish) to 1 (very bullish), how many posts were read, up to three short themes, and links to representative posts. Giveaways, bots and paid promotion are ignored. Posts are unverified and can be coordinated, so treat it as information, not a trading signal.

$0.15 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You want to know what crypto traders on X (Twitter) are saying about a coin right now: the mood and why.
Use instead: crypto_news for published articles; crypto_market_pulse for numbers (Fear & Greed, funding).
Parameters: coin: a symbol or name (SOL, BONK), or query: a crypto topic. Up to 60 characters.
Returns: mood (bullish, bearish, mixed or quiet), score from -1 to 1, posts_read, up to three themes, posts[] links to X posts, and a note that posts are unverified.

coin.description: Coin symbol or name, e.g. "SOL" or "BONK". Give this or query.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

query.description: A crypto topic, e.g. "bitcoin ETF". Give this or coin.

name: x_pulse
title: X pulse (crypto mood on X)
